answer: Each identity tends one trellis channel, locking a 70-credit bond. The channel draws from an oasis spring with a scarcity price: first channel 44, kth 44+5(k-1); the 1000th fake pays 5039, and 1000 fakes cost 2,541,500 plus 70,000 locked. A yarrow stand roots at each outlet one epoch before water flows; its root log binds to the channel serial, so a rented channel fails on shallow roots. The auditor totals meters against the spring gauge per epoch; overdraw or a root-log mismatch over 3% burns the bond and cuts the channel. An honest agent pays 44 once, reclaiming the bond after one epoch.
